verdict.rationale: Bugbot leaves inline PR comments with explanations and 'suggested fixes' (cursor-bugbot-docs-13, cursor-bugbot-docs-24), but the evidence shows fixes are applied via 'Fix in Cursor' or 'Fix in Web' links that open the issue in the Cursor IDE or cursor.com/agents rather than a native one-click committable diff/suggestion block directly on the PR (cursor-bugbot-docs-3, cursor-bugbot-docs-4, cursor-bugbot-docs-15, cursor-bugbot-docs-16). This implies an extra step of launching an agent to implement the fix rather than a single in-PR click-to-commit suggestion. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of a native GitHub/GitLab 'commit suggestion' style one-click diff applied directly in the PR UI, and independent confirmation that the Fix links result in a ready-to-merge diff without additional agent steps.
